questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure ExpressRoute?

options.text: A VPN model that uses routing to determine which traffic enters encrypted tunnels and is preferred for many modern scenarios

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

ExpressRoute circuit: the private connectivity path used to connect a site to Microsoft cloud services.
